name: Athens, Greece

visa.notes: Financially independent person visa requires ~€2,000/mo income proof. Renewable annually.

rent.notes: Spitogatos Q2 2026 asking rents: central, southern and northern Athens suburbs about 11.8 EUR/sqm, cheapest Attica areas about 7.5 EUR/sqm; a 90-100 sqm pet-friendly 2-3BR therefore runs roughly 800-1200 EUR in ordinary areas, more in the south coast. Wise/Numbeo 2026 puts a 3BR outside the centre near 940 EUR and in the centre near 1140 EUR; Athens-centre asking rents rose 6.9% in the year to Q1 2026.

sources.title: To Vima: Greece's Hottest Rental Markets (Spitogatos Q2 2026)
Wise: Cost of Living in Athens 2026
Spitogatos blog: Q1 2026 annual changes in asking prices

groceries.notes: Two adults at roughly 250-270 EUR each (Wise/Numbeo Athens 2026 gives about 268 EUR per person) plus 100+ EUR/month of food for a large-breed dog (Athens Times, July 2026). Food CPI was only +0.9% y/y in August 2026 and IELKA finds the Greek supermarket basket the cheapest of 10 European countries.

utilities.notes: Electricity, heating, water, sewer and municipal fees (billed on the power bill) for 2 adults in an 85-100 sqm flat: Expatistan 168 EUR and Wise about 173 EUR per month, before the November 2026 PPC green tariff rise to 0.169 EUR/kWh (+6.2%, other suppliers +30-76%) and the EYDAP fixed-charge rises from January 2026; housing/utilities CPI was +14.7% y/y in September 2026. Winter central heating (oil/gas) drives the max.

healthcare.notes: Non-EU resident retirees (FIP permit) must hold Greek private health cover and, without EFKA contributions, rely mainly on it; Feather (Apr 2026) prices basic plans at 50-100 EUR and mid-range at 125-250 EUR per person per month, Crete Direct (Jun 2026) 80-150 EUR per person depending on age. Two 60-year-olds on basic-to-mid plans: about 260 EUR for two; minimum-compliance visa policies (about 150 EUR/yr) set the floor.

insurance.notes: Re-modelled from old template (health) to renters/contents cover. COSMOTE Insurance/Hellas Direct contents-only policies for tenants cost 18-54 EUR per year for 6,000-25,000 EUR of cover (2023 launch pricing); fuller apartment policies start around 140 EUR/yr.

petDaycare.notes: Attica boarding kennel (Chris's Animal Hotel, Kalivia near the airport) charges 17 EUR per night plus 24% VAT, about 21 EUR including food; typical assumes roughly 4 boarding nights per month on average (two trips a year plus occasional day boarding).

sources.title: Chris's Animal Hotel, Kalivia Attiki - prices

transportation.notes: One small car: basic third-party insurance about 150 EUR/yr (driver 36-65, Magenta/Cosmote Insurance Athens quote) to 290 EUR/yr comprehensive, fuel 1.85-2.00 EUR/L, road tax unchanged for 2026, plus maintenance; or transit-only at about 27 EUR per monthly pass (half price from age 65). Transport CPI +11.3% y/y in September 2026.

phoneCell.notes: Two SIM-only postpaid lines: Nova SIM 15 at 15 EUR, Cosmote M 20 GB at 22 EUR, Vodafone Red 30 at 25 EUR, unlimited Vodafone Red+ at 42 EUR (Feb 2026); earlier Cosmote/Vodafone unlimited plans were 33-41 EUR. Typical = two mid plans.

healthcare.system: EOPYY national health system. Public hospitals adequate but strained. Private clinics good and affordable.
healthcare.waitTimes: Public: 4-12 weeks for specialists (system under strain). Private: 1-2 weeks.
healthcare.prescriptionCoverage: Public covers most prescriptions with co-pays of 10-25%
